g.text: Diamonds: median of 5 trial medians. Open marks: the 5 trial medians. Lines: their observed range, not a confidence interval.
Raw measurements + mask; frozen fitted inference. Includes validation, feature state, learned score, guards, alert and backend synchronization.
All displayed cases passed feature/score tolerance and exact eligibility/alert checks against raw-window FP64 recomputation.
Excludes training, calibration, compilation/allocation, network and production queuing. Ordinary desktop scheduling; fixed thread settings.
Synthetic repeated histories are not efficacy evidence. No Rust sphere-placement engine exists; these timings are a different workload.
